data.name: Jayabal
data.gender_notes: Jayabal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jayabal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaya' meaning victory and 'Bala' meaning God. It represents the victory of God over all obstacles and challenges in life. The name Jayabal carries the meaning “Victory of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Jayabal usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jayabal is a spiritual name that signifies the victory of the soul over the material world and the attainment of spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Jayabal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayabal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
